candidates.description: This vector represents the concept of the Thai copula verb 'pen' (to be) and English equivalents like 'be' and 'an'.
This vector represents common Thai character combinations, prefixes, and syllable components.

This vector is sensitive to common consonant letters of the Thai alphabet.
These tokens represent Thai consonants combined with the vowel sound /ɔː/ or as standalone consonantal characters in Thai script.
The feature vector represents the root concept of existence, being, and outward transition, frequently capturing variations of the prefix "ex-" and related ontological terms across languages.
This vector activates across a diverse mix of multilingual subword tokens and fragments without a unified semantic theme.
